name: Dogran's Captivity
summary: At Camp Taurajo, a warlock faces a vital trial in Horde training: rescue a captured orc warrior. With Ken'zigla's Draught, you must find battered Grunt Dogran in a quilboar camp and give him strength to escape.

sections.title: A Lonely Rescue
sections.body: Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo will not risk Horde soldiers in a costly attack on the entrenched quilboar. Dogran's fate rests with you, an aspiring warlock armed only with Ken'zigla's Draught. Travel north through the brambles and hostile camps to find where the quilboar hold him captive.

sections.title: The Price of Blood
sections.body: Grunt Dogran lies badly battered among hostile quilboar in huts north of Taurajo. Ken'zigla's Draught gives him enough vigor to hobble to safety, but his injuries leave him permanently maimed. He loses an arm and a leg.

faq.answer: Grunt Dogran is held in a small cluster of two quilboar huts directly north of Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why won't Grunt Logmar send soldiers to help?
faq.answer: Grunt Logmar cannot spare troops from Camp Taurajo's defense. He considers a rescue in heavily guarded quilboar territory too dangerous to risk more military lives.
Ken'zigla's Draught is a potent, foul-tasting restorative tonic brewed to give the gravely injured Dogran enough strength to stand and escape quilboar captivity.

faq.q: What condition is Dogran in when found?
faq.answer: Dogran is on the brink of death, with extensive wounds and torture at the quilboar's hands. Even after drinking the draught, his arm and leg are damaged beyond repair.

faq.q: How does this rescue relate to summoning a succubus?
faq.answer: Dogran carries a token tied to love and mortal devotion, emotions and ideas warlocks exploit to summon and bind a succubus.
Dogran was captured by quilboar tribes living in the brambles north of Camp Taurajo.

angles.text: As a warlock, you face a vital step toward understanding mortal passion and sacrifice, which are needed to summon a succubus.
As a member of the Horde, you know quilboar endanger patrols and outposts throughout the central Barrens.
As an orc, you can see Dogran's endurance through maiming and torture as the fierce resilience expected of an orcish grunt.
